ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity (white) to 65% low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches at the distal 20% of each fluke lobe. The central 60% of the horizontal span is dominated by low-intensity black pigmentation with sparse high-intensity speckling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, becoming more pronounced towards the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, following a parabolic trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) concentrated at both distal tips. Sparse white circular scarring (diameter 3-10 pixels) scattered across the dark central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear segments (rake marks) detected; prominent parallel vertical marks on the lower right lobe and scattered diagonal lines on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge; multiple linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct circular dark pigmentation spot or hole located on the upper-right lobe within the white-pigmented zone near the trailing edge boundary.
